CMOS differential commutating mixer
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
VCM vcm 0 1.65
VIP vip 0 SIN(1.65 0.1 1.1meg)
VIM vim 0 SIN(1.65 -0.1 1.1meg)
VLO lo 0 PULSE(0 3.3 0 1n 1n 499n 1u)
XDUT vdd 0 vip vim vcm outp outm lo astra_033_cmos_passive_commutating_mixer
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec if_cos range 0.05 0.075 unit=V
* @spec if_sin range -0.008 0.008 unit=V
* @spec dc_offset range -0.005 0.005 unit=V
* @spec rf_leak range -0.008 0.008 unit=V
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 2n 120u
let vd = v(outp)-v(outm)
let ic = vd*cos(2*pi*100k*time)
let iq = vd*sin(2*pi*100k*time)
let rf = vd*sin(2*pi*1.1meg*time)
meas tran if_cos AVG ic FROM=20u TO=120u
meas tran if_sin AVG iq FROM=20u TO=120u
meas tran dc_offset AVG vd FROM=20u TO=120u
meas tran rf_leak AVG rf FROM=20u TO=120u
write out.raw
quit
.endc
.end
